arguments.prompt: Medium shot with a long lens of a mauve fabric banner hanging between the limestone columns of a semicircular portico, filling the frame width, lit by low raking winter sun from the left. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. The only movement: the fabric breathes very slightly in a light wind - a slow soft ripple travelling along it, the fold near the middle lifting and settling, the lettering staying perfectly legible and undistorted throughout. Nothing else moves; the stone is fixed. No people. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
